name: Cillian Murphy
bio:
Cillian's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by tales of rallying legends and the roar of engines echoing through his grandfather's workshop. He honed his meticulous nature through countless hours spent disassembling and reassembling engines, developing a keen eye for detail that quickly became his defining trait. He believes that quality control isn't just about ticking boxes; it's about ensuring every component performs flawlessly, contributing to the team's overall success. 

His methodical approach, coupled with his loyalty, makes him a valuable asset to any team. Cillian understands the high stakes in motorsport, and he's committed to preventing errors and maximizing performance. He aspires to rise through the ranks and eventually lead a team of quality control specialists, setting the standard for excellence within the industry.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight quiff.
physical.description: Cillian is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when concentrating.
Insists on calibrating his instruments before starting any inspection.
